passages.title: Recording 1: The school concert
passages.text:
Girl: Dad, Mrs Palmer says everyone in the orchestra has to take something to the concert tomorrow evening.
Man: Not your music stand again? It's still in the car from last time.
Girl: No, the school's got plenty of those now. And they've borrowed chairs from the church hall, so we don't need to bring our own. It's the lights, actually. The hall will be quite dark while we're playing, so we all need a small torch to read our music.
Man: I think there's one in the kitchen drawer. I'll check the batteries.

passages.title: Recording 2: The Year 9 trip
passages.text:
Boy: Did you hear about the Year 9 trip? We were supposed to be going to the castle, but Mr Hughes says the coach company can't do that date.
Girl: So is it cancelled?
Boy: No, they've changed it. We're going to the science museum in the city instead, because the train goes straight there. Some people wanted the farm park, but that's closed until the spring.
Girl: Oh well, the museum's got that new space exhibition, so I don't mind.

passages.title: Recording 3: Tonight's homework
passages.text:
Woman: You're not playing computer games already, are you? What about your homework?
Boy: I've done the maths worksheet. I finished it at lunchtime. And the science poster isn't due until next Friday.
Woman: So there's nothing else?
Boy: Well, there's the history essay. Mr Dean wants it on his desk first thing tomorrow morning, and I've only written the introduction.
Woman: Then the games can wait, can't they?

passages.title: Recording 4: Sports day
passages.text: Woman: Hello, this is a message for all parents from Kingsmead School. Sports day is going ahead this Friday, but please note that the start time has changed. The races were going to begin at half past ten, but because very hot weather is forecast for the afternoon, the first races will now start at quarter past nine. Students should arrive at school at nine o'clock as usual, wearing their PE kit, and bring a bottle of water. Thank you.

passages.title: Recording 5: The art competition
passages.text:
Girl: Guess what, Gran? I came first in the school art competition!
Woman: Oh, well done, love! What did you get? Last year the winner got a big box of paints, didn't they?
Girl: They did, but I've already got loads of paints. This year the winner got a ticket for the new exhibition at the city gallery, and I can take someone with me. The girl who came second got a book of famous paintings.
Woman: That sounds lovely. So who are you taking?
Girl: You, of course!

passages.title: Recording 6: Parents' evening
passages.text:
Man: Excuse me, I'm here for the Year 10 parents' evening. Is it in the library, like last term?
Woman: Not this time, I'm afraid. The library's being painted this week. We'd planned to use the dining room, but it's too small for all the teachers' tables, so everyone's in the main hall. Just go down this corridor and it's the double doors on your left.
Man: Great, thanks very much.

passages.title: Recording 7: The talent show
passages.text:
Girl: Are you going to be in the talent show, Josh? I thought you might play your guitar.
Boy: I did think about it, but loads of people are doing music. And I'm definitely not dancing. You've seen me try!
Girl: So what are you going to do, then?
Boy: I've been writing some funny stories about school life. I'm going to stand up on stage and tell jokes. Mr Grant says it's fine as long as I'm kind about the teachers.
Girl: That'll be brilliant.

questions.question: What does the girl need to take to the school concert?
questions.explanation: The girl says the hall will be dark, 'so we all need a small torch to read our music'. The school already has 'plenty of' music stands, and chairs have been borrowed from the church hall, so she does not need to take either.

questions.question: Where are the Year 9 students going on their trip?
questions.explanation: The boy says 'We're going to the science museum in the city instead'. The castle was the original plan but the coach company cannot do that date, and the farm park is 'closed until the spring'.

questions.question: Which piece of homework does the boy still have to finish tonight?
questions.explanation: The history essay must be on Mr Dean's desk 'first thing tomorrow morning' and the boy has 'only written the introduction'. He has already done the maths worksheet, and the science poster 'isn't due until next Friday'.

questions.question: What time will the first races start on sports day?
questions.explanation: The message says 'the first races will now start at quarter past nine'. Half past ten was the old start time, and nine o'clock is when students should arrive at school, not when the races begin.

questions.question: What did the girl win in the art competition?
options: a) a ticket for a gallery exhibition
b) a book of famous paintings
c) a big box of paints
questions.explanation: The girl says 'This year the winner got a ticket for the new exhibition at the city gallery'. The box of paints was last year's prize, and the book of paintings went to the girl who came second.

questions.question: Where is the parents' evening taking place?
questions.explanation: The woman says 'everyone's in the main hall'. The library is being painted, and the dining room was planned but is 'too small for all the teachers' tables'.

questions.question: What is Josh going to do in the talent show?
questions.explanation: Josh says 'I'm going to stand up on stage and tell jokes'. He decided not to play the guitar because 'loads of people are doing music', and he is 'definitely not dancing'.
